subject.title: BL-ecommerce-coupons-27: coupon validation trusts client-sent shipping cost and regional surplus

question: Should this coupon prevalidation fix land as a coupon-only server-side recalculation now, or be folded into the shared checkout shipping/total validation work tracked by https://github.com/Hamelyn-SL/hamelyn-serverless/issues/6920?
rationale: The expected trust boundary is clear, but the previous correct-looking fix was size/L and overlaps with a broader payment-boundary calculation issue, so maintainers should choose the sequencing and shared-service boundary before another implementation attempt.

options.title: Share calculation with checkout first
options.body: Build the shared server-side shipping calculation once and wire both checkout validation and coupon prevalidation to it, reducing drift between the two trust boundaries.

options.title: Patch coupon validation first
options.body: Land a narrower coupon endpoint fix now using destination and priority inputs, accepting that checkout total validation will still need a coordinated follow-up.

options.title: Wait for BL mother issue
options.body: Hold this child divergence until the Coupons & Promotions BL block publishes validated specs and tests, trading speed for stricter BL sequencing.

recommendation.title: Share calculation with checkout first
recommendation.body: Build the shared server-side shipping calculation once and wire both checkout validation and coupon prevalidation to it, reducing drift between the two trust boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the named Coupons & Promotions BL owner and recent coupon validation contributor, so he is the best available owner for the coupon-side sequencing choice.
